title.zh: 费用（社会与家庭发展部）（撤销）命令 2024
title.en: Fees (Ministry of Social and Family Development) (Revocation) Order 2024

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Fees (Ministry of Social and Family Development) (Revocation) Order 2024.
2. Revoke the Fees (Ministry of Social and Family Development) Order 2012 (G.N. No. S 525/2012).

3. Despite paragraph 2, the Fees (Ministry of Social and Family Development) Order 2012 (called the revoked Order) continues to apply in relation to any appointment of the Director‑General of Social Welfare as guardian ad litem in adoption proceedings under the repealed Adoption of Children Act 1939 in any of the courts mentioned in paragraph 2 of the revoked order.
